subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the supplied production evidence enough to start a focused Discord reconnect repair, or should maintainers require a fresh live current-main 1005/1006 reproduction first?
rationale: The report has credible latest-release live evidence, but current main has partial adjacent retry work and the exact failed reconnect transition still needs either maintainer-accepted log proof or a live/harness reproduction before an autonomous repair is safe.

options.title: Require current-main reconnect proof
options.body: Keep this open for maintainer follow-up until a live Discord or transport-harness run reproduces the established-runtime 1005/1006 no-recovery path on current main.

options.title: Proceed from production logs
options.body: Accept the v2026.6.11 logs as sufficient to promote a focused Discord reconnect repair, with live proof required before merge.

options.title: Split the fallback control
options.body: Track the channel-scoped reconnect command separately and keep this issue focused on automatic WebSocket recovery.

recommendation.title: Require current-main reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open for maintainer follow-up until a live Discord or transport-harness run reproduces the established-runtime 1005/1006 no-recovery path on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent gateway supervision and lifecycle history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
